verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's plan/apply separation (tofu plan -out=FILE, tofu show -json, tofu apply plan.out) provides a solid mechanism for an agent to produce a reviewable, machine-readable plan and have a human/gate approve it before apply, confirmed by hands-on probes. However, there is no evidence in this pack of built-in policy-as-code enforcement (e.g., Sentinel/OPA-style gating) or least-privilege credential scoping features specific to OpenTofu, so the 'cannot make unapproved changes' guarantee relies on external tooling/CI wiring rather than native product capability.
